guides.favoredWhen: Win the trades and deny his teamfight casts; never give him a free objective setup.

keyTips.text: You win the trades, so this is your skill matchup to decide with your support. Take the straight fight with them and never without them.
With your support beside you this is his hardest lane. Duel him — he wants teamfights and objectives with Deadly Flourish and Curtain Call instead.
Your dash ({cd:236:E}) is what he tracks above everything else. Vary its timing and never slide predictably into his root.

early-lane.text: Jhin loads his fourth shot on a minion and holds it to zone you off the wave. Trade while it is spent and give ground while it is held.
Deadly Flourish is a follow-up for support crowd control, not dry poke. A wasted W is your window to walk up.

win-condition.text: A landed Deadly Flourish sets up a guaranteed first Curtain Call shot when fired instantly. Break vision lines and stay mobile once it connects.

tips.text: Force straight trades with your support. His burst loses them, so make him fight your fight from the first waves.
Trade while his fourth shot is spent and give ground while he holds it. The loaded shot zones you off the wave even without firing.
Walk up when he wastes Deadly Flourish ({cd:202:W}) dry. Without the follow-up root he has no answer to your burst.
Meet his objective groups and force the duel. His W-plus-R plan needs range and setup; your burst inside it wins.
Sweep the objective flanks for his traps and fog picks. Denied vision denies his casts, and he cannot set up what he cannot see.
Win through duels, not casts. Chase him off objectives with your dash rather than trading W-plus-R volleys at his range.
Break vision and stay mobile once his root connects. The instant Curtain Call shot after it is guaranteed unless you are already moving.

itemization.text: Build to duel. Your win is the 1v1 and the short trades he refuses, so spend for burst rather than poke.

keyTips.text: Spend short-range windows pressuring with Q through minions plus passive-enhanced attacks.
Start all-ins after the support lands control or the enemy burns an important escape or defense.
Flank teamfights from side angles; Lucian plays closer than long-range ADCs without ever frontlining.

tips.text: Check the enemy jungler before committing; a mistimed close trade can lose the lane outright.
Hold passive-enhanced attacks off the wave unless pushing stays intentional, keeping the lane safe.
Poke Q directly when open, or thread it through a minion to reach opponents outside direct range.
Pressure tanks and the frontline with R, then E out once an assassin closes in.
Threaten with brushes and flank setups instead of walking blind into unseen space.
Turn lane pressure into early Dragon and Baron control; Lucian fades later, so close while the lead lives.
Flank the backline only after control and peel threats are spent before stepping close.
Spend E defensively on divers, since its mobility answers lockdown best.
